user_duration_requirement: approximately one minute, slightly longer is acceptable
approved_opening_copy: Ktoś powierzył ci swoją historię. Teraz chcesz ją przekazać dalej — i chronić osobę, która ci zaufała.

audience_proposal.primary_user: journalist or reporter handling sensitive information
audience_proposal.initial_buyers: Polish newsrooms and civil society organizations
audience_proposal.status: recommendation, not yet a user-confirmed market decision
audience_proposal.spoken_copy: Projektujemy to urządzenie dla dziennikarzy i organizacji społecznych, które pracują z wrażliwymi informacjami.

story_assumption: Project presentation combining future product concept and real prototype demonstration; no commercial availability claim.

preferred_transition.action: Reporter lightly tosses the enclosure onto a dry matte metal counter under the station shelter; cut at contact to the matching closed Blender enclosure. A brief stylized layer opening feeds the existing simultaneous closure.
preferred_transition.match_reference: Author the contact frame in Blender before generating the Seedance shot. Match the dry counter, camera, enclosure pose/scale, cold overhead lighting and motion. Keep the composition bright enough to read the product. Evaluate and adjust the generated shot in the edit.
preferred_transition.existing_scene_change: Current v09 starts exploded; add a closed contact pose and approximately 0.6–0.8 seconds of opening. Avoid a pause at the reversal.

sections.visual: Night, sheltered exterior station concourse. An anonymous source walks away; the fictional reporter closes a notebook. Side/back view, dark cap and jacket, tracking camera; rain stays in the background.
sections.audio: Chosen opening copy from ElevenLabs only, added in edit. Separate rain, distant train and footsteps; no generated human voices.
sections.source: Seedance proposed; generation access not connected

sections.visual: Reporter walks a few steps to a dry matte metal counter beside a closed kiosk under the same shelter. Brief look back, takes out the enclosure and lightly tosses it onto the counter; camera follows into the Blender contact composition.
sections.audio: Audience sentence from ElevenLabs only. Separate cloth and enclosure contact sound lead into CG.

sections.visual: Closed contact pose → brief exploded view → simultaneous assembly → move left → Raspberry Pi prototype → cable connection → matched live-action frame. Simple labels identify phone, cable, gateway and LTE if needed.
sections.audio: Explain that the design connects a phone by cable to a separate LTE gateway, with phone radios switched off; avoid implying the whole system is radio-silent.
sections.source: Adapt v09 Blender and compositing; retain its continuous motion rather than uniformly slowing it down

sections.visual: Real prototype, actual phone settings and wired connection, then a readable result from a genuine connection test.
sections.audio: Describe only functionality shown and verified in the captured configuration.
sections.source: New real footage; existing still is a temporary preview placeholder
sections.conditional: Tor result only after actual deployment and verification. The local mock-check-tor page is a mock, not evidence of Tor routing. If Tor is not ready, show the actual connection test and identify protection features as planned.

sections.visual: Return to future product concept: phone attachment, compact enclosure, OLED, short closing shot; keep subtle motion.
sections.audio: Name the next development step and invite pilot conversations with newsrooms/organizations. CTA is a proposal, not a claim that pilots already exist.
sections.source: Blender product concept; MagSafe shot must use a consistent phone model
sections.conditional: Battery, PCB, OLED and attachment remain proposed engineering features; no invented mass, runtime or test results.

narration_target.method: Generate a complete coherent narration, measure actual timing, then finalize shot durations. Reserve short sound-only transitions without freezing the picture.

preview_delivery.comment: Current v09 remains the delivered preview; this plan does not initiate rendering or API charges.

creative_constraints.confirmed_setting_direction: outside an apartment; prefer an exterior location
creative_constraints.proposed_location: Sheltered exterior concourse of a railway station at night, beside a closed kiosk and a dry matte metal standing counter.
creative_constraints.location_status: assistant proposal, not confirmed by user
creative_constraints.character: Fictional reporter in an ordinary dark cap and jacket; source leaves the frame. Restrained gestures and tension.
creative_constraints.lighting: Cold overhead pools of light, a distant warm practical light, wet pavement in the background, product contact surface dry.
creative_constraints.visual_continuity: Maintain recognizable reporter and product references across shots; preserve the final Blender contact composition.

audio_plan.seedance_audio_request: Only non-vocal environmental and contact effects if audio is generated. No dialogue, voiceover, whispers, singing, crowd chatter or station announcements.
audio_plan.edit_policy: Import Seedance picture without its audio track. Add ElevenLabs narration and separate ambience/foley tracks in the edit. Generated Seedance SFX are optional reference material; do not automatically mix the original soundtrack.
sfx_palette: controlled enclosure contact with the counter
audio_plan.narration_direction_proposal: Quiet, close, composed, restrained urgency; clear Polish delivery with forward momentum. Final voice direction to audition.

seedance_shot_plan.action: Source leaves; reporter closes notebook; camera tracks alongside.
Reporter approaches the sheltered counter, brief glance over shoulder, hand goes to device.
Close tracking view of hand and enclosure; low controlled toss, contact and final composition matched to Blender.

seedance_generation_trial.reference_role: product identity, not first frame or studio environment
seedance_generation_trial.transition_scope: First trial of scene/motion. Exact contact-frame match requires review and possible end-shot regeneration.
